node_note: every node names the vertex set it certifies a pathwidth for (vertices are the instance's 0-based customer labels); a `branch` node is S, three branches (nodes), three connectors Q ⊆ S with one edge to each branch, and certifies k + 1 where every branch certifies ≥ k; a `c` node is the C program's output on the induced subgraph relabelled 0..m-1 in increasing label order (edges_sha256 as obstruction-minor-1); a `clique` node is a clique of the induced subgraph (pathwidth ≥ size − 1); a `trivial` node is one vertex; a `minor` node carries an obstruction-minor-1 certificate of the induced subgraph
theorems: branch_lemma_separator / branch_lemma_linked (lean/MOSPFormalization/Sandwich.lean) for every branch node; card_le_pathwidth_add_one_of_isClique (MOSPGraph.lean) for a clique leaf; the C program's refutation on a branch rests on the corrected search rules (Search/) and its bound on degeneracy_le_pathwidth / minDegreeIn_le_degeneracy (Sandwich.lean); pathwidth_gt_of_minorOf (Minor.lean) for a minor leaf; mospValue_eq_pathwidth_add_one (MOSPGraph.lean) for the optimum units
